title: Cross-tissue transcriptomic module reproducibility analysis
description: Analysis code and supporting materials for evaluating reproducibility and interpretational limits of cross-tissue transcriptomic module projections. The release contains no redistributed raw GEO expression matrices or other third-party data.
notes: The private GitHub repository has been created and the initial commit was pushed according to the repository owner. Public accessibility, the immutable v1.0.0 release tag, any related article identifier, and the Zenodo DOI remain pending and must be verified before public release.
